rows.coder_note: "EBI database" is a repository name covering many GWAS (Table 1 lists eight different PMIDs, no accession); the anemia dataset is given only as 484,598 Europeans with case counts. No accession, no linked reference entry, and no single dictionary row is identified.

rows.quote: The anemia outcome was derived from FinnGen consortium R11, encompassing 138,342 European individuals (33,700 cases and 104,642 controls).
rows.coder_note: "FinnGen consortium R11" names release 11 (rule A); Table 1 also writes "Finngen R11" throughout. The 138,342 is an endpoint-specific N, not a conflict (rule H).
